Run the model-authored corrected script ONCE via `python tools/m05_adopt_guard.py tools/history_adopt_completion.py`. It does NOT author/import/revise geometry. Do not use the exhausted old m05_blender.py guard or remove/reset any old claims. In that single actual Blender process: first reopen BOTH old materialised scenes without saving, prove the two exact stable-ID cube instances are one metre tall, units METRIC/1, original external texture decodes to 8x8 and hashes fcf1e3f027e9b1ea14df033cba5b5134a7db305f9fc69239f517abb1be932568, and retain every historical source hash unchanged. THEN explicitly adopt the existing 1.5-metre asset-cube-v3 into ONLY the working scenes/fixture/scene.blend, preserving scene instance IDs/transforms/animation/camera/timeline, with actual linked Red material and metre units. Save only that declared scene via a fresh temporary sibling and promote after successful validation. Preserve scenes/alternate/scene.blend and all asset/research/old report bytes. If the native process succeeds, use checkpoint_sources for ONLY scenes/fixture/scene.blend, tools/history_adopt_completion.py and reports/history-adoption-completion.json, with actual HEAD as expected_head. Then publish ONLY scene-main-v2 on item scene-main, expected_current_version_id scene-main-v1, with exact asset-cube/asset-cube-v3 source dependency, truthful description and preview_requests:[]. Build SourceClosure from actual scene/report/source hashes and the exact existing dependency origins from get_version(asset-cube-v3), correct project repository ID, returned source commit and canonical digest using installed proscenium.contracts. Validate before publish_outputs. No asset revision, no alternate scene publication and no new preview/proxy/still are needed. Do not call Git add/commit directly or include unrelated guard/dirty files.

Finish with actual historical measurements/texture evidence, adoption readback, preserved-state checks and exact source/version/publication IDs. An explicit owner operation already authorises this main-only adoption, so do not impose an extra creative approval stage. The previous failure remains in history, unaltered.

I’ll preserve the failed attempt and its reports, copy the script, and restrict selection to the exact object ID and two required instance IDs. The renewed guard will run once; only a successful readback and save will lead to main-scene publication.

The main scene then passed its 1.5-metre geometry and `Red` material assertions, but stopped before saving at a path-equality check: the library path retained `../..` components.
